Separate a structural ordering operator from physical time and from its later analytic realization.
Separate directional distinguishability from coordinates and a physical metric.
C(deltaOmega) is introduced; its function, measure and units remain unspecified.
Bind particular mode eligibility to a declared operator/model; stationarity and resonance do not establish localization.
A formula describes a model and constrains candidates; a wave does not physically generate the formula by being its argument.
Three is a conditional simple-loop cardinality. A rule application needs three mode instances, joint constraints and a separate result.
rho=|Psi|^2 and Gamma=integral rho are different quantities. Neither is alone a closure or localization certificate.
Objecthood is the conjunction of localization, nontrivial concentration and persistence. Existing bounded studies admit no CRT instance.
Specify independent fields, variation and boundedness before using the formula as a formation mechanism. The frozen cubic preflight is negative.
Multiple objects do not automatically constitute a collective regime; coupling and collective persistence need independent evaluation.
Keep alternative coupling families with declared variables/units and input/output types.
A collective order descriptor needs a definition and measurement window; synchrony is not sufficient for carrier promotion.
An ensemble-quantum is a proposed collective carrier; do not infer empirical quantization or a Standard Model particle.
Require a forward coarse-graining map, valid effective transitions and evidence. No direct derivation of established quantum fields is available.
Omega supplies the formal background; it is not a measured universal root or a generated physical object.
The catalogue puts its frame before directional primitives; the paper constructs the analytic metric from those directions and additional assumptions.
The scale and E=hbar omega are introduced. A linear proportionality with continuous omega does not derive a discrete spectrum.
Reconcile the operator/mass sign and distinguish an internal scale from a proof of resistance to dispersion or localized objecthood.
An argmin operates on a declared candidate cohort, functional and coefficients. Preserve tied alternatives; do not treat selection as a universal parent.
No sufficiently specific derivation of this directional branch was located in the fully read topology paper; do not infer it from the time/space signature.
The paper discusses persistence under perturbations, not the full named anisotropic deformation mechanism. Its relation to object identity needs a separate test.
A gradient needs a defined admissibility functional, domain, units and differentiation rule; the current name does not define them.
A directional support claim needs an actual displacement/flux observable and mechanism. None is derived for this named node in the reviewed topology paper.
